assumptions: CLI route: `--metric cvvdp` errors without a display; counted path is the display scorer (run_metric_display/run_metric_hdr_u8 -> CpuCvvdpDisplayScorer, metrics/cvvdp_cpu.rs) with the canonical standard_4k display (Eotf::Srgb + BT.709, ppd=75.402449): Cvvdp::score (pipeline.rs:371-391) = srgb_to_dkl_planar x2 + score_internal (pipeline.rs:837-897).

Pyramid levels NL = n_levels from band_frequencies(ppd,W,H) (kernels/pyramid.rs:272-291): for ppd 75.40 the 0.2 cy/deg cutoff lands at candidate index 7 -> NL = min(8, floor(log2(min(W,H)))-1). NL=8 at all default eval shapes except 256x256 (NL=7).

Per side: 3 gauss pyramids (achromatic A also serves as gauss_l; built once, shared - pipeline.rs:3037-3144), L-1 luma expands shared across channels (fill_l_expands, pyramid.rs:700-734), weber bands per channel (weber_bands_from_gauss_lexp, pyramid.rs:737-851).

Gaussian reduce = Burt-Adelson 5-tap separable + 2x decimation (kernels/pyramid.rs:66-153): v-pass writes sw*dh intermediate (~2 outputs-worth), h-pass 5-tap -> per output element 15 mul + 12 add + 15 load + 2 store (counting the vscratch store); boundary patch adds excluded (few % of elements).

Expand = zero-insert + 5-tap separable x2 gain (kernels/pyramid.rs:171-228): per output element 9 mul + 6 add + ~7 load + ~1.5 store (z-buffer scatter counted in store); fused expand+weber variant (expand_fused_weber_pass) counts the same plus the weber fold.

Weber band: clamp((fine - img_exp)/max(l_exp,0.01), +-1000) - zenmetrics_math vweber_band_nolog (kernels.rs:312-348): sub 1, div 1, cmp 3. ch0 shares the luma expand (no img expand); ch1/ch2 run the fused expand+weber.

CSF apply (non-baseband): gather_lerp_exp3_apply (zenmetrics-math kernels.rs:832-920): shared bracket (sub+mul+2cmp+floor+frac-sub+cvt) per element; per channel lerp LUT (2 gathers + fma + sub) + exp((v+off)*scale) + (in*(band_mul*sens))*gain on both images = 2 mul + 2 ld + 1 st each.
Baseband takes apply_csf_diffs (pipeline.rs:102-124): per-channel unfused gather_lerp_exp + (t-r).abs()*sens.

Masking (non-baseband): gaussian_blur_sigma3_minabs_scaled (simd_pyramid.rs:1720-1735,2728-2746) = 13-tap sigma-3 separable blur of min(|T|,|R|)*mask_c_lin per channel; then mask_fold_pool (zenmetrics-math kernels.rs:704-810): per channel safe_pow(tm^q) + safe_pow(|t-r|^p) + XCM 3x3 pool + du/(d_max) fold.

Pool: lp_norm_mean3 (kernels/pool.rs:174-194) per band per channel: acc += (|x|+eps)^p - eps^p (p=BETA_SPATIAL); barrier; then lp_norm_sum over levels/channels (BETA_BAND=4, BETA_CH=4) + IMAGE_INT + met2jod (pow).
powf/exp/log10 from the math policy (Midp/archmage) counted as ONE op of their class (library call, v2 conv.1); fast-ssim2's inline cube root was the contrasting case.
Ref side ch0 additionally writes log_l_bkg (store per element per level) - folded into baseband/weber store counts.
score() early-outs on identical inputs (10.0) - counting the distinct-input path.
diffmap (want_diffmap) not produced by the plain score path - not counted.
bytes_* = compulsory traffic; LUT/CSF-table gathers appear in 'load' only.

Canonical-path pyramid count: 3 gauss pyramid builds per side (caches[0].gauss_l shared across channels + caches[1].gauss_img + caches[2].gauss_img; build_one_side_recycle, pipeline.rs:3037-3144) - the strip path instead builds 4 per side (redundant ch0 gauss_img, pipeline.rs:967-1047). Per side per level: 1 materialized l_expand (fill_l_expands, shared by all 3 channels) + 2 fused chroma img expands inside weber_chroma (gausspyr_expand_weber never materializes the expand, pyramid.rs:799-815); ch0 uses same_img_l -> no img expand.

stages.name: sRGB8 -> display linear -> DKL (A,RG,VY) planar
stages.notes: LUT path (standard_4k is Srgb+Bt709): 3 u8 loads + 3 LUT f32 loads + 3x (s*lin+bias) fma + 3x3 DKL matvec (9 mul + 6 add) + 3 stores.

stages.name: 5-tap reduce: vertical pass
stages.notes: v-pass writes the full sw*dh intermediate plane (PyramidScratch.vscratch, kernels/pyramid.rs:66-153). 3 builds/side (shared gauss_l), x2 sides.

stages.name: 5-tap reduce: horizontal pass + decimate
stages.notes: h-pass over vscratch emits band l+1 into the persistent WeberPyramid Band.data (full).

stages.name: l_expand vertical pass
stages.notes: v-pass reads the coarse column (5 taps, coarse y spacing) into vscratch[sw x out_h] (kernels/pyramid.rs:184-204); ~N_l/2 elements. Shared across all 3 channels (fill_l_expands, pyramid.rs:700-725).

stages.name: l_expand horizontal pass
stages.notes: h-pass over vscratch at coarse-x positions writes the full l_exp[k] plane (pyramid.rs:206-227).

stages.name: achromatic weber band (shared-l expand)
stages.notes: band = clamp((fine - l_exp)/max(l_exp, 0.01), +-1000). ch0: img_exp IS l_exp (same_img_l, no extra expand).

stages.name: RG/VY weber bands (fused img expand + weber)
stages.notes: expand_fused_weber_pass = expand taps (9 mul + 6 add + ~7 ld + ~0.5 st) + weber fold (sub + div + 3 cmp + 1 st) on the fine grid; reads img_coarse (0.25 el/el) + fine + l_exp -> 9 B.

stages.name: baseband: sum(l.max(0.01)) -> mean; band = fine/mean (+log_l fill ref ch0)
stages.notes: Per ch: mean of clamped luma (sum reduce: cmp+add+ld) then fine/l_bkg_mean (div+ld+st); ref ch0 also fills log_l_bkg (log10 once + store/elem) -> store 4/3 avg.

stages.name: CSF sensitivity x T_p/R_p (non-baseband bands)
stages.notes: Shared bracket per element (sub,mul,2cmp,floor,frac-sub,cvt,int); per channel: 2 LUT gathers + lerp(fma+sub) + (v+off)*scale + exp + band_mul*sens + 2x((in*bg)*gain: 2ld+2mul+1st). All 6 T/R planes.

stages.name: baseband |T-R| x sensitivity (unfused per-ch gather)
stages.notes: Per channel: full bracket (add2 mul1 cmp2 cvt2 int1) + 2 LUT ld + lerp (fma+add) + (v+off)*scale + exp + (t-r).abs()*sens (sub+abs+mul) + 2 ld + 1 st. x3 + 1 log_l ld.

stages.name: mask blur: min(|T|,|R|) + 13-tap horizontal
stages.notes: pu_blur_fused_inner: h-filtered rows live in a 13-row ring (ring_scratch >= 13*w, simd_pyramid.rs:2189-2260); min(|a|,|b|) rides a 14th ring row. No h_pass plane is materialized.

stages.name: mask blur: 13-tap vertical + mask_c_lin scale
stages.notes: v-pass + mask_c_lin scale writes the masking strength plane (full).

stages.name: safe_pow mask terms + XCM pool + du/(d_max) fold, 3 ch
stages.notes: Per ch: pw=(|t-r|+eps)^p-eps^p (sub+abs+add+pow+add+blend/cmp), tm=(m_mm+eps)^q-eps^q (add+pow+add+cmp); m_c=XCM 3x3 dot (3mul+2add) + du=pw/(1+m) (add+div) + d=dmax*du/(dmax+du) (mul+add+div). Loads: t,r,mm x3ch + tv shared + pw.

stages.name: lp_norm_mean3 spatial pool (BETA_SPATIAL) per band
stages.notes: acc += (|x|+eps)^p - eps^p per element per channel (elements = 3 x level dims at level l); finalize safe_pow_lp(acc/n)^(1/p) per band trivial.

stages.name: lp_norm_sum over bands/ch + met2jod
stages.notes: Per level-channel: level[c]*w*sband_w (2 mul) + pow + acc add; finalize: 3x safe_pow_lp + lp_norm_sum(3) + q*IMAGE_INT + met2jod (cmp + pow + mul + sub).
